facts.fact: Minister Zerbo/Sabane said on 11 November 2026 that the unique identifier platform and its data are hosted in Burkina Faso in the State's data centres and run by Burkinabe engineers.
The pilot of the unique identifier register enrolled more than 16,000 people in urban and rural areas before the mass enrolment launched on 11 November 2026, per the minister.

facts.fact: The minister said on 11 November 2026 that the identifier platform is administered by Burkinabe engineers.
President Traore said on 11 November 2026 that Burkina Faso designed and controls its own identification system, with tools developed by Burkinabe engineers and public structures.

BFA.note: No other register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Burkina Faso launched mass enrolment into the Registre de l'identifiant unique on 11 November 2026, assigning each person a random 12-digit electronic identifier, after a pilot enrolling over 16,000 people.
The minister said the system captures face, ten fingerprints and both irises and deduplicates them against everyone already registered before generating the identifier.
The minister said on 11 November 2026 that the identifier platform and its data are hosted in the State's data centres in Burkina Faso.
